name: Activity Calendar Chart UI Block
description: Create a reusable activity calendar chart section that makes daily patterns legible at a glance. Its warm-neutral editorial styling combines an ink canvas, clay surfaces, and teal intensity cells for product analytics and executive reporting.
whatYouGet: A responsive, date-aligned daily activity grid
Readable intensity legend and range labels
Editable component styling and sample data
goodFit: Executive reports embedded in web pages
Reusable analytics sections in an existing app
notFor: A complete dashboard with filters and navigation
requiredInputs: Daily values associated with calendar dates

faq.q: Can the displayed period be changed?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the date range configurable and derive the displayed weeks from the supplied dates and week-start setting.
Use explicit, documented value bands and make them configurable when the data scale varies between uses.

demoPrompt: /sl-activity-calendar-chart-ui-block Create a SaaS usage report section for readers to scan yearly activity, with the headline “A Year Of Steady Activity” and three summary stats: 1,284 active projects, 312 days with activity, and the busiest day, Sep 12, with 18. Use the skill’s restrained Clay Ledger style.
followUpPrompts: Add a configurable comparison period and a small previous-year summary.
Adapt the activity values and labels for weekly publishing frequency.
externalCostNote: No external services. Runs entirely on your agent.
